Evacuated to Holsworthy, Devon during the Second World War
Attended Dr Challoners Grammar School in Amersham
Conscripted for national service after the Second World War

Worked as a print advertisement model in early 1950s
Roles in American TV shows and films in late 1950s and early 1960s
Filmed a Maverick episode with James Garner two seasons earlier
Appeared in The Roaring 20s episode Right Off the Boat
Directed nine episodes of the later series of The Saint
Roles in several theatrical films in the 1970s and 1980s
Married Dorothy Squires in New York
Became a resident of Monaco after appointment as Goodwill Ambassador of Monaco
Joined BECTU as an apprentice animation technician
